args.title: Incident summary: double charge on retry
args.body: Customers on the payments flow were being double-charged, affecting roughly 40 orders per day. The technical cause is that `retry.py` does not carry the idempotency key across the second capture attempt, so the retry is processed as a separate charge. The fix — persisting the key before the first capture — is confirmed in staging and sits in PR #481, which is not yet merged, so the impact is ongoing in production.
